description: Send a chat completion through Conduit Router: policy-checked, budget-checked, metered, and audit-receipted. Uses your own stored provider keys (BYOK). Pin a model as "provider:model" or let your standing terms choose.

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on the completion's output tokens.

messages.description: OpenAI-shaped messages: [{role, content}] with role system|user|assistant|tool.

model.description: Optional pin: "provider:model" (e.g. "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile"), "custom:<endpoint_id>:<model>", or a bare catalog model id.

task_profile.description: Optional routing profile: reasoning (deepest models), tool-use, or bulk (cheapest/fastest). Defaults to your standing terms.

name: route_chat
title: Route a chat completion
